name: SpecExec massively parallel speculative execution on RTX 4090 with RAM offload: Llama-2-70B batch 1
unit: speedup_ratio: 8.3x speedup over sequential offloaded autoregressive decoding (throughput increased to 5.66 tok/s with generation rate 13.46 accepted tokens per iteration). BASELINE: standard autoregressive decode with RAM offloading on RTX 4090.
methodology: Batch size 1 (interactive decode), RAM offloading over PCIe. Target model: Llama-2-70B GPTQ 4-bit; draft model: Llama-2-7B. Speculative budget: 256 candidate tokens. Hardware: single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 24GB. Dataset: OpenAssistant (OASST).
notes: Table 3 in arXiv:2406.02532. Highlights the extreme win of massive speculation in RAM offloading settings: when target forward passes take seconds due to PCIe transfer, evaluating a tree of 256 candidate tokens in parallel yields 13.46 accepted tokens per step, reaching 5.66 tokens/s (8.3x speedup). On 16-bit unquantized Llama-2-70B with budget 2048, speedup reaches 18.7x (3.12 tok/s).
